create_dicttensor_from_tensors: create a DictTensor from a dictionary of PyTorch tensors with a shared batch dimension
get_dicttensor_n_elems: get the number of batch elements in a DictTensor using the n_elems method
access_dicttensor_keys_and_values: access tensor values by key and list variable names via keys on a DictTensor
create_temporal_dicttensor_with_lengths: create a TemporalDictTensor from tensors with variable sequence lengths specified via the lengths argument
slice_temporal_dicttensor: slice a TemporalDictTensor temporally using temporal_slice to restrict sequences to specific time indexes
